tasks.label: Export Slides to PDF
args: set -e && bun --bun slidev export --format png --output temp_folder && for file in temp_folder/*.png; do num=$(basename "$file" .png); padded=$(printf '%03d' "$num"); mv "$file" "temp_folder/$padded.png"; done && img2pdf temp_folder/*.png -o "${input:outputFileName}.pdf" && rm -rf temp_folder && echo 'PDF created: ${input:outputFileName}.pdf'

inputs.description: Enter the output PDF filename (without .pdf extension)
